notes.title: update 1.4.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Here's the latest and hopefully last update.
Here's what's new:

- Fixed VLADIMIRO achievement
- Added a HINTS fix in the cheat room in case you REALLY get stuck
- Fixed a scene in the gallery that left the screen black
- Fixed a typo in a couple of scenes

As for the VLADIMIRO achievement, there's the chance that it still won't work on your save, and if so, it's because RPGMaker is a stupid bitch. Try exiting the dungeon boss room and re-enter it, and if it still gives you the bug I apologize but you'll really need to do a new run. 

Thank you for being still there Buniboys, have fun!
-Hassel

notes.title: Achievements & Content Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We're finally at 1.4.0. Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] ACHIEVEMENTS FIXED! WAHOOOO!
[*] You can unlock Steam Trading Cards by playing the game, these can be collected to earn emotes and backgrounds!
[*] Added some crossover scenes with other characters from the Hyanmaruverse. You can access them by entering the chimney in the first house on the right in the village.
[*] Added final CGs to all endings.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented Jack from gaining stat points.
[*] The final CG of the “fake” ending (the one you get after beating the 4 bosses) now has several variants. The man who impregnates Sunny is randomly selected based on the characters you recruited.
[*] Fixed a bug that made Hobo’s scene in the Angel Room inaccessible.
[*] Hobo’s scene at the church is now displaying the correct version.
[*] Adjusted the entrance size of the house in the woods so that the boulder correctly blocks the exit.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Sunny x Tomm x Jack scene in the Air Dungeon.
[*] A man who was incorrectly appearing in Stella’s room should no longer show up (lol).
[*] Hobo’s dong no longer gets stuck on your screen.
[*] Added a bug-fixing NPC (a slime ball) in the Cheat Room, in case you get stuck.
[*] If your game crashes frequently, try talking to the bug-fixing NPC in the Cheat Room—he should fix the issue.
[*] The black man at the inn will now creampie Sunny just like the white man does (consistency!).
[*] Fixed some dialogue boxes during the end credits.
[/list]
